The term carries a deep cultural significance as it serves as a reminder of the Islamic historical heritage and the rooted belief in the oneness of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: Hanifiyyah represents a spiritual commitment to purity of faith and devotion to Allah without any intermediaries or idols. It serves as a reminder of the fundamental tenets of Islam, namely the belief in Tawheed (the oneness of Allah) and the rejection of shirk (associating partners with Allah). The term carries a deep spiritual significance as it inspires believers to strive towards sincere devotion and unwavering faith in the One and Only Allah.
